name: Baas Radley
description: A one-handed ogre shaman and former Gruul warrior who collapsed the Jezeru dams, now a tattoo artist, who teaches Arrus her healing ink.

timeline.summary: Arrus tries to steal the ink of the ogre shaman, who beats him up, and Selesnyan vine magic from spilled ink heals him.
timeline.quote: Slowly, but surely, I feel my broken bones mend.

timeline.summary: Arrus follows the ogre to a hydra cave where she steals an egg using a goblin skull lure, and they flee together.
timeline.quote: The ground erupts, spewing rock and stone as a steep ramp forms ahead of us.

timeline.summary: Arrus recognizes the ogre as Baas Radley, the shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams.
timeline.quote: Wait. You're Baas Radley. The shaman who collapsed the Jezeru dams?

timeline.summary: Baas teaches Arrus to face down a charging battleboar herd and offers to send him to Burning Tree Clan and teach him her ink recipe.
timeline.quote: You're too good to toss to the Wilds.

timeline.summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
timeline.quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

timeline.summary: Arrus discovers that trees on the Selesnyan border are only five years old, planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Selesnya had planted thousands and thousands of saplings, and then accelerated their growth until they had the perfect impenetrable barrier.

timeline.summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
timeline.quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

relations.note: She teaches him her ink recipe and combat tricks.
relations.quote: I'll show you how to make the ink.

relations.note: Daeska was her partner but did not wait for her.
relations.quote: Turns out, I got released early, only to find out that tramp hadn't even waited ten months.

pages_say.description: A one-handed ogre shaman and former Gruul warrior who collapsed the Jezeru dams, now a tattoo artist, who teaches Arrus her healing ink.
